Subject: PO 4721: PO acceptance payload and remit details needed

Hi Irene,

Thanks — we received Redwood's invoice/PO notice but need a quick handshake to validate the PO acceptance payload and remit instructions before AP completes the first payment. Attached is our PO (AtlasGrid_PO_4721.pdf).

Can you confirm:
- The JSON/XML payload you'll send to our PO-ack webhook (we need field mapping for buyer_order_number, line_item.sku, and remit_reference)
- The bank remit details you will use (we need beneficiary name + IBAN for EU processing or ACH routing for US)
- Tax docs needed (we require W9 or EU VAT cert per our vendor class)
- Whether Redwood will register as a vendor in our ProcureTech portal (portal prefers vendor ID and one primary contact)

Our AP requires the vendor to be registered in ProcureTech with a vendor_id and a PO acceptance that includes the acceptance_timestamp and internal_po_reference. If you can drop a short sample payload and the remit instrument, we can fast-track payment.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — payment is tied to a May 31 milestone.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Senior Procurement Manager
AtlasGrid

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@atlasgrid.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO 4721: PO acceptance payload and remit details needed

Hi Samira — thanks for the PO and the clear checklist. Happy to confirm and share the payload. A few clarifying points so we align with AP expectations: 

1) Payload format: We can send either JSON (preferred) or UBL/PEPPOL XML. If JSON, we will include these top-level fields:
   - purchase_order_id (maps to your buyer_order_number)
   - acceptance_timestamp (ISO 8601)
   - lines: [{sku, description, qty, unit_price}]
   - remit: {method, account_holder, iban, routing_number, remit_reference}

2) Remit: Redwood will provide US ACH details for the hosted account and a separate EUR IBAN for EU customers. Which will AtlasGrid use for PO 4721? If ACH, we will provide account holder name exactly as on bank records + routing/account numbers. If IBAN, we will provide beneficiary and SWIFT.

3) Tax: We will attach our W9. For EU VAT we can provide VAT registration evidence on request (we have a US entity and an EU branch).

4) Portal registration: We can self-register in ProcureTech if you provide a vendor invite link (or we can provide the details you need and you can create the record). For speed, if ProcureTech supports a vendor_id pre-provision, you can tell us the vendor_id and we will populate our payload with vendor_id and primary_contact.

I attached a small sample payload you can forward to AP (redwood_po_payload_sample.json). Jordan, looping you for bank remit confirmation and to validate the GL code mapping request below.

Samira — can you confirm which remit instrument you will route the payment to (ACH or IBAN) and whether ProcureTech will accept a vendor_id we provide or if you must create the vendor record? Once we have that, we will send the signed W9 (attached) and the PO acceptance webhook test to your sandbox endpoint.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head, Customer Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_po_payload_sample.json (application/json, 2KB), Redwood_W9.pdf (application/pdf, 60KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 21 May 2025 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: PO 4721: PO acceptance payload and remit details needed

Irene — quick internal note before we send anything externally:

- Confirm bank remit proof: For ACH we'll send an ACH micro-deposit test or bank letter; for IBAN we'll send beneficiary proof (bank letter).
- GL mapping: AtlasGrid asked about GL code mapping; ask finance if we should include billing_code on the acceptance payload (I think yes, field billing_code).
- Billing contact: Marissa, can you provide the primary finance contact and confirm whether we should use Redwood US parent or the EU branch for invoicing on this customer? The decision affects tax docs.
- Risk: Since payment is milestone-driven, propose we include both acceptance_timestamp and an acceptance_signature (simple HMAC) in the payload so ProcureTech can verify authenticity.

If you want, I can draft the vendor registration request for ProcureTech and send it to Samira, or we can ask Samira to invite us.

-Jordan
